Independently RNE and saturate each f32 operand product to i8, add the resulting bytes exactly in i32, optionally ReLU, then multiply in f32, RNE and saturate to i8. Require zero output-code error against the selected two-load device model. This software-model screen is not RTL qualification or a source/provider proof; those remain mandatory. Pooling, bias, residual extensions and accumulator-full exits are outside this contract. Every distinct readout scale needs its own full screen.
